title: Installation of fittings.
officialText:
Fittings shall be installed to guide sewage and waste in the direction of flow. Change in direction shall
be made by fittings installed in accordance with Table 706.3. Change in direction by combination fittings, side inlets or increasers
shall be installed in accordance with Table 706.3 based on the pattern of flow created by the fitting.
TABLE 706.3
FITTINGS FOR CHANGE IN DIRECTION
CHANGE IN DIRECTION

TYPE OF FITTING

Sixth bend X X X
Quarter bend X Xa Xa
Short sweep X Xa,b Xa

Wye X X X
Combination wye
X X X
and eighth bend
For SI: 1inch = 25.4 mm.
a. The fittings shall only be permitted for a 2-inch or smaller fixture drain.
b. Three inches or larger.
c. For a limitation on double sanitary tees, see Section 706.3.
SECTION PC 707
